## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Explain any change to methods or public
documentation.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Note any checks that could not be completed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the relevant documentation is current.
- [ ] Tests, lint, formatting, and package checks have been run as appropriate.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic; no patient data or generated outputs are included.
- [ ] The target direction, training-fold boundaries, and non-clinical scope are preserved.
